findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: detect_language, clinical_verify · Private data: translate, translate_batch, analyze_direction, clinical_translate, clinical_query, health · Public sink: analyze_direction · Destructive: wrap_for_display, strip_nikud, delete_term.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: detect_language, clinical_verify · Private data: translate, translate_batch, analyze_direction, clinical_translate, clinical_query, health · Public sink: analyze_direction · Destructive: wrap_for_display, strip_nikud, delete_term

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
